perplexity.description:
The Heart Is Strange is a 2022 studio album by xPropaganda, the project of original Propaganda vocalists Claudia Brücken and Susanne Freytag, reunited with legendary producer Steve Lipson. Released on the ZTT label, the album marks the first full-length studio effort by these core members in nearly four decades, following their acclaimed 1985 debut A Secret Wish. Musically, The Heart Is Strange blends electronic and pop elements, featuring bold synth textures, driving rhythms, and Brücken and Freytag’s distinctive vocals. The sound pays homage to Propaganda’s pioneering synth-pop roots while incorporating contemporary production, with tracks like “Don’t (You Mess With Me)” and “The Wolves Are Returning” echoing the band’s signature blend of drama and melody.

As a comeback album, The Heart Is Strange stands as a significant chapter in the Propaganda story, bridging their influential past with a modern sensibility. It was met with positive critical reception, praised for its “sonically thrilling, boundary-pushing pop music” and its ability to resonate with both longtime fans and new listeners. Commercially, the album reached No. 11 on the UK Albums Chart, surpassing the chart positions of any previous Propaganda release. The album’s success and critical acclaim affirm xPropaganda’s enduring relevance in the electronic and pop music landscape.
